chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch.420: The Second Origin Sound and the Dead World's Sovereign
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen's three-year cultivation hits a plateau at Perfected Man realm. He ventures into Dead World depths seeking the second primordial 'Duo' tone, facing skeleton Heavenly Kings.
og_title: The Dead World Beckons – World of Immortality Ch.420
og_description: After the massacre, Xiao Chen retreats to the Dead World, but stagnation drives him toward a dangerous quest for the second Origin Sound and a mysterious female sovereign.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen's power stalls, so he plunges into the Dead World's heart seeking the Duo tone and a female sovereign's secret.
